g.text: How Joint Genotyping Uses Population Signals to Improve Accuracy
Problem: Is Sample_1 truly homozygous ref, or is there a real variant we're missing?
Result: Cohort consensus confirms Sample_1 is truly 0/0. Uncertain call is reinforced by population evidence.
Key Scenarios Where Population Power Provides Maximum Benefit:
Why: Weak individual signal reinforced by
Why: Rare variant validated by population
Why: Singleton call identified as sequencing

Core Insight: Joint genotyping improves UNCERTAIN calls by borrowing strength from the population. High-confidence calls remain stable. This simultaneously reduces false positives (artifacts) and increases true positive detection (weak real calls).
